tools.name: get_dilution_snapshot
tools.description: Headline dilution metrics for one ASX company — risk level, cash cover band, market cap, 12-month raise count and options & rights overhang % (the JSON key remains max_dilution_pct — a contract). Mirrors the free company page. Works without a key, ~20 calls/day.

tools.name: get_raise_history
tools.description: Every capital raise on record for one ASX company: date, type, amount, issue price, shares issued, brokers and stated purpose. Identical to the paid page's raise history.

tools.name: get_options
tools.description: The option and convertible register for one ASX company — every line's code, security kind (options, performance rights, notes, warrants, rights), type (price-triggered, condition-triggered, converts on terms, not classified), exercise price, expiry and quantity. Free and keyless (~20 calls/day), id

tools.name: get_cash_runway
tools.description: Quarterly cash, burn and cover history (IQ Cash) for one ASX company. Identical to the paid page's cash detail.

tools.name: get_issuance_timeline
tools.description: The share-issuance timeline for one ASX company — every issuance-relevant filing, dated and cited. Identical to the paid page's timeline.

tools.name: screen
tools.description: Screen the ASX universe by dilution risk, cash cover, market cap or industry. Returns at most 20 rows — always the top of the requested ordering; there is no offset paging. A discovery tool, not an extract. Filters: q (name/ticker search), risk, cover, cap, industry, suspended, sort, dir. Companies

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_raise_history · Private data: get_raise_history, get_options · Public sink: get_issuance_timeline.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_raise_history · Private data: get_raise_history, get_options · Public sink: get_issuance_timeline

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
